paragraphs: Zunin. A folded document came before Rabbi: in the king’s first year it was dated the second. Rabbi said, “It is postdated.” Zunin told Rabbi, “This nation’s custom is to count two for a king who has reigned one year, three for two.” The sages instituted a folded document according to that custom, to distinguish an ordinary from a folded document. Rashbam explains: Zunin is a sage’s name, Bava Batra 164b. Zunin asked in the study house: Shabbat 81a.
